Did you know the Fed just froze interest rates while NVIDIA's revenue exploded by 265 percent?

[IMAGE: Federal Reserve building exterior]

The Federal Reserve held its benchmark rate steady at 5.25 to 5.50 percent this week. Inflation is still running above their 2 percent target, so don't expect cuts anytime soon.

Meanwhile, NVIDIA just dropped a bombshell earnings report. Twenty-two point one billion dollars in a single quarter. That is a 265 percent jump from last year, and it is almost entirely driven by demand for their AI chips — the H100 and the upcoming B200.

[IMAGE: AI microchip close-up with glowing circuits]

But here is where it gets interesting. Bitcoin quietly crossed $70,000 for the first time. Institutional money is flowing in through the new spot ETFs, and that is changing the entire dynamic of the crypto market.

[IMAGE: Bitcoin digital currency coin with upward graph]

So what does all this mean for you? We are in an economy where AI spending is accelerating, interest rates are stuck high, and crypto is going mainstream through traditional finance.

[IMAGE: stock market trading floor with digital screens]

The money is moving. The question is — are you paying attention?
